docs: Chapters content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of chapters, each with a picture, a short label, a title and a line. One object is valid in every chapters layout (rows with the picture at the side, a pair).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.docs: the chapters, in the order they are read

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.docs: address of the picture of the chapter; none: the placeholder

title.docs: the title of the chapter (the alt text of the picture)

description.docs: one paragraph about the chapter; empty: none
